history_hint: Geocentric tropical zodiac. Each row is an interval with the displayed signs. The new sign applies from each ingress; retrograde re-entries remain separate.
no_exact: No exact aspect in this interval.
clipped_start: Already active at the query start; the actual onset may be earlier.
clipped_end: Still active at the query end; the actual end may be later.
overlap_hint: Other events from the complete calculation, regardless of chart filters. Times show the actual overlap; equal start and end indicate a shared instant.
no_overlap: No other events overlap this range.
legend: Bands: within orb / retrograde · ◆: exact aspect · dashed line: sign ingress. Aspect signs: first body above, second below. See details for narrow intervals. Each chart page spans up to 30 elapsed days and 12 lanes.
all_scope: Scope: all calculated events, independent of display filters. Compare event times on the timeline for overlaps.
selected_scope: Scope: selected event and a list of overlapping events.
convention: Times use the selected zone with UTC offsets. Event and ingress times display seconds; the 0.125-second root-solving stop criterion is not an absolute ephemeris accuracy guarantee.
